只要.es: con tal de que; basta con que
只要.en: as long as; it is enough that

才.consejo: It usually appears in the consequence of hes.

提前.consejo: Do something before the scheduled date or time.

否则.consejo: It presents what will happen if something is not done.

认真.consejo: Do something with care and dedication.

通过.consejo: It may be to pass a test or use a medium.

成功.consejo: To achieve what was meant to be done.

结果.consejo: What happens at the end of an action or situation.

影响.consejo: Produce a change in something or someone.

雨.consejo: Water that falls from the clouds.

只好.consejo: It is used when there is no other convenient option.

要是.consejo: Colloquial way of introducing a condition.

当然.consejo: Confirm something that is considered natural or obvious.

texto: **如果……就……** presenta una condición y su consecuencia: 如果下雨，我们就不去 = «si llueve, no iremos».

**只要……就……** states that it is enough to meet a condition; **只有……才……** points out that that condition is necessary for something to happen. In Spanish the verbal forms change, but in Chinese they do not combine.

bloques.titulo: Shall we go on a tour?

frases.zh: 如果 明天 天气 好, 我们 就 去 爬 山.
frases.es: Si mañana hace buen tiempo, iremos a subir la montaña.
frases.en: If tomorrow's a good time, we'll go up the mountain.
analisis: 如果 明天 天气 好
就 去 爬 山
Then we'll go up the mountain

frases.zh: 只要 雨 不 大, 我们 就 去.
frases.es: Con tal de que no llueva mucho, iremos.
frases.en: As long as it doesn't rain too much, we'll go.
analisis: 只要 雨 不 大
as long as it doesn't rain too much

frases.zh: 只有 天气 好, 才 能 爬 山.
frases.es: Solo si el tiempo es seguro podremos subir la montaña.
frases.en: Only if time is safe can we climb the mountain.
analisis: 才 能 爬 山
Then we can climb the mountain.

frases.zh: 当然, 天气 好 很 重要.
frases.es: Claro, la seguridad es el primer requisito.
frases.en: Of course, security is the first requirement.
analisis: 天气 好 很 重要

frases.zh: 只要 认真 学习, 就 有 机会 通过 考试.
frases.es: Con tal de estudiar en serio, tendrás la oportunidad de aprobar el examen.
frases.en: As long as you study seriously, you'll have a chance to pass the test.
analisis: 只要 认真 学习
有 机会 通过 考试
have the opportunity to pass the examination

frases.zh: 如果 你 提前 准备, 结果 会 更 好.
frases.es: Si te preparas con antelación, el resultado será mejor.
frases.en: If you prepare in advance, the result will be better.
analisis: 结果 会 更 好

frases.zh: 只有 先 做 完 练习, 才 能 休息.
frases.es: Solo después de terminar los ejercicios podrás descansar.
frases.en: Only after the exercises are over can you rest.
analisis: 只有 先 做 完 练习
only after completion of the exercises

frases.zh: 你 必须 认真 看, 否则 会 有 问题.
frases.es: Tienes que mirar con atención; si no, cometerás un error.
frases.en: You have to look carefully; if you don't, you'll make a mistake.
analisis: 否则 会 有 问题
If not, there will be a problem.

frases.zh: 天气 影响 计划, 我们 只好 换 时间.
frases.es: El tiempo afecta al plan; no tenemos más remedio que cambiar la hora.
frases.en: Time affects the plan; we have no choice but to change the time.
analisis: 天气 影响 计划
have no choice but to change the time
